page_title: ALA 0-0 VAL | Alaves v Valencia 20/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Iosu Galech is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' The players claim that Lucas Boye (Alaves) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jonny Otto (Alaves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Iosu Galech who sees an offensive foul.
89' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
88' The corner from Carles Alena (Alaves) is intercepted by the defence.
88' A mistake by a defender gifts Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
88' Denis Suarez (Alaves) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
86' The attendance is 15564.
85' Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Iosu Galech and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Diego Lopez (Valencia) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
80' Substitution. Hugo Duro leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).
80' Here is a change. Javi Guerra is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia).
80' Eray Comert comes onto the pitch because Jose Copete (Valencia) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
80' Jose Copete (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

79' Jon Guridi (Alaves) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
77' Fouls committed – 9:15.
77' Iosu Galech has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dani Raba (Valencia).
75' The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Lucas Boye (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
71' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Jon Guridi (Alaves) is replacing Toni Martinez.
71' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Arnaut Danjuma will be replaced by Dani Raba (Valencia).
70' Toni Martinez (Alaves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to find Hugo Duro, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
65' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Lucas Boye (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' Iosu Galech blows his whistle as Lucas Boye (Alaves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
63' Toni Martinez (Alaves) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
61' Substitution. Calebe will be replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
60' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Suarez (Alaves) replacing Pablo Ibanez.
60' That will be all from Abderrahmane Rebbach who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Carles Alena (Alaves).
58' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
55' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

54' Toni Martinez (Alaves) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Julen Agirrezabala pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
52' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.

50' Toni Martinez (Alaves) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
44' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

44' Jonny Otto (Alaves) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.

40' Lucas Boye (Alaves) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target.
39' Lucas Boye (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
37' It looks like Thierry Correia (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Iosu Galech won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
34' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
33' A crossfield pass from Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.

32' Lucas Boye (Alaves) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Julen Agirrezabala, who tips the ball around the post.
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yusi (Alaves) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Lucas Boye (Alaves) is put clean through inside the box by Calebe, but he gets right under the ball and sends it just over the bar. Should have been a goal!
25' Calebe (Alaves) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
25' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Pepelu (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
20' A cross into the box from Yusi (Alaves) is cleared.
18' Some great play by Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
14' Half-chance! Jose Gaya (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera reacts well to snuff out the attack.

11' Luis Rioja (Valencia) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
11' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Iosu Galech interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Valencia win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
8' Iosu Galech couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yusi (Alaves) and blew his whistle.
5' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
2' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Iosu Galech is the one to supervise the game today.
